Traffic advisory

Police are assisting Halifax Regional Fire and Emergency with a natural gas leak in the area of Pinecrest Drive and Jackson Road in Dartmouth.

Evacuations are underway in the following areas: Leaman Drive, west to Pinecrest Drive. Albro Lake Road, north to Crystal Drive.

Police are asking the public to avoid the area.

Any further questions should be directed to Halifax Regional Fire and Emergency.
